description: This Java source file defines an abstract helper class for creating and configuring an SSH client, utilizing the Apache SSHD library. It features a singleton pattern for the SSH client instance and sets up necessary configurations such as identity loader, key exchange factories, and signature factories.

classes.name: SshClientHelper
classes.description: An abstract utility class providing a singleton SSH client setup with default configurations, using the Apache SSHD library.

methods.name: getSshClient
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of SshClient configured with default identity loader, key exchange mechanisms, and signatures. Initializes and starts the client if it is not already started.
